item.immersive_trains.rotary_cannon.desc: Póca gastaigh le gunpowder atá ag rith.
item.immersive_trains.bomb_bay.descripti: Droichid TNT, nach scriosann blocanna ach déan maith damáiste.
item.immersive_trains.heavy_crossbow.des: Croisbhóthar trom le pasáige d'áit, teastaíonn laige.
item.immersive_trains.airship.descriptio: Airships may not be the fastest vehicle, but they sure are easy to maneuver.
item.immersive_trains.cargo_airship.desc: Mhall ionsabail agus ag ithe breosla ach aCarry an stór ar fad.
item.immersive_trains.warship.descriptio: Dún forta, mall ach armáilte go trom.
item.immersive_trains.biplane.descriptio: Tapa agus rather a spraoi. Déan cinnte go bhfuil do rún leordhóthan.
item.immersive_trains.gyrodyne.descripti: Who needs an engine if one could power the aircraft with pure brawn? Give it a good push and off it flies!
item.immersive_trains.quadrocopter.descr: A masterwork of engineering! 4 rotors strapped to some bamboo. Perfect for building, and that's about it.
item.immersive_trains.bamboo_hopper.desc: Aerárthach gafa le trí shéat agus pontoons chun tuirlingt go sábháilte ar uisce.
immersive_trains.gyrodyne_target_reached: Sceideal cuaille íostéite, réidh le haghaidh éirí!
immersive_trains.invalid_dimension: Ní oibríonn an t-aerárthach seo sa diméoin seo.
immersive_trains.fat.out: Tá tú rómhór ocrach chun eitilt!
